metadata.name: payvand
metadata.description: On-chain payment records for Payvand QR payments

instructions.name: close_budget
docs: Reclaim whatever is left in the budget and retire the session key.
One wallet signature — the buyer gets every lamport back.

instructions.name: close_token_budget
docs: Drain the token vault back to the buyer and retire the budget. One
wallet signature; every token and lamport comes back.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates the singleton fee policy. Callable once, by the program's
upgrade authority, which becomes the admin — so no caller can install
an admin of its choosing.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The upgrade authority: pays for `Config` and becomes its admin.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: upgradeable loader's PDA for this program id and the owner check pins it
to that loader, so a decoy account cannot stand in for it. The handler
reads the upgrade authority out of it.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The fee destination. Created outside this instruction (it needs no data
and no signature), and pinned here by its seed.

instructions.name: open_budget
docs: Buyer funds this month's spending budget and registers a session key.
This is the ONE wallet signature the whole feature needs: afterwards
the session key — an app-generated keypair stored on the device — can
settle invoices from the pot without touching the wallet again.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Main wallet: the one signature the buyer ever makes.

accounts.name: session_key
docs: the only key allowed to spend from the budget afterwards.

accounts.name: config
docs: Supplies the session float, so a policy change reaches every new budget.

instructions.name: open_token_budget
docs: Buyer opens (or tops up) this month's budget for one token and
registers a session key for it. One wallet signature per token; after
that the session key settles token invoices from the vault without
touching the wallet again.

accounts.name: buyer_token_account
docs: Where the budget's tokens come from — the buyer's own account.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The pot itself: a token account owned by the budget PDA, so only this
program can ever move what is inside it.

accounts.name: session_key
docs: the only key allowed to spend from this budget afterwards.

instructions.name: open_treasury_token_account
docs: Opens the treasury's own token account for a mint, paid by the admin.
A mint the treasury has no account for cannot be settled: the fee has
nowhere to go, and the buyer would only find out after signing. Run this
once for every mint the app can price in, before its first invoice.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Pays the account's rent. The treasury's own lamports are the pool the
fee is measured against, so they are not spent on accounts.

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: The fee's destination in this mint: the treasury's own account, created
here when it is missing and left alone when it is not.

instructions.name: pay_from_budget
docs: Silent payment: the session key settles an invoice straight out of the
buyer's budget — no wallet popup, because the only signature here is
the local session key's. The pot pays the seller and refunds the
invoice rent it just advanced from the session key's float.
The monthly cap and the pot balance are both enforced here, and the
amount still rides in the payment PDA's seeds, so a QR code can only
ever be settled for exactly the price it shows — the same guarantee
`settle_payment` gives.

accounts.name: session_key
docs: Session key: fee payer and rent payer (made whole by the pot in this
same transaction). Never the buyer's wallet.

accounts.name: seller
docs: allowed to receive the lamports.

accounts.name: reference
docs: seed and an address watchers can look up.

accounts.name: config
docs: The fee policy. Read-only here.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The fee destination and the refund source, pinned by seed.

instructions.name: pay_from_token_budget
docs: Silent token payment: the session key settles a token invoice out of
the buyer's vault, with no wallet popup. The monthly cap, the vault
balance and the amount in the invoice seeds are all enforced here, and
only the session key registered at open time may spend.

accounts.name: session_key
docs: Session key: fee payer and rent payer (refunded from the budget's float
in this same transaction). Never the buyer's wallet.

accounts.name: seller
docs: of the invoice account's close.

instructions.name: settle_payment
docs: Buyer pays an invoice. The invoice account is created (and funded by
the buyer) inside this same transaction, so the seller never has to
sign anything to open a payment code — the QR is just an address plus
its details.
`amount` is part of the PDA seeds, which is what keeps this safe: an
invoice can only ever be settled at the exact amount that was encoded
into the QR code, because any other amount derives a different account
address than the one the seller is watching.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays for the invoice account, the receipt, and the transfer itself.

accounts.name: payment
docs: Short-lived: created, settled and closed in this one transaction. Its
rent goes back to the seller, who fronts no signature for it.

accounts.name: seller
docs: account allowed to receive the lamports.

accounts.name: receipt
docs: The permanent record. `settled_at != 0` means this invoice is done, so
the same invoice can never be settled twice.

accounts.name: reference
docs: used as a PDA seed and as an address that watchers can look up.

accounts.name: config
docs: The fee policy. Read-only here: only the admin writes it.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The fee destination, pinned by seed so the payer cannot name another
account. It also refunds the receipt rent the payer just advanced.

instructions.name: settle_token_payment
docs: Buyer pays a token-denominated invoice straight from their wallet.
Same guarantee as `settle_payment`: the amount rides in the PDA seeds,
so an invoice can only ever be settled for the exact price its QR
shows. The mint is in the seeds too, so a USDC invoice and a SOL
invoice that happen to share a reference and a price are different
accounts and cannot pay for each other.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Advances the invoice and receipt rents and the network fee; the treasury
refunds both rents in this same instruction, so the buyer's lamports
loss is the network fee alone and the price is all they pay.

accounts.name: seller
docs: through its own associated token account, checked below.

accounts.name: seller_token_account
docs: The seller's own token account, which must already exist. Creating one
here would mint rent to whoever named the seller, so opening it is the
seller's setup step — like having a wallet at all — and never a line on
the buyer's bill.

accounts.name: reference
docs: and an address watchers can look up.

accounts.name: config
docs: The fee policy, read-only here. Same rules as the SOL path.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The SOL pool: it refunds the rents the payer advanced and receives the
invoice rent back when the invoice closes.

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: The fee's destination in this mint, opened once per mint by whoever runs
the treasury; the contract cannot create it without paying rent to a
seller's account, which is the faucet this avoids.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Changes the fee policy. Admin only; it never rewrites `admin` itself.

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury
docs: Moves treasury surplus to the admin, leaving its rent-exempt minimum.
No payment path can touch the treasury this way.

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Payment amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: AlreadySettled
errors.msg: This payment has already been settled

errors.name: InvoiceTooSmall
errors.msg: This amount cannot cover the invoice account's rent

errors.name: InvalidSeller
errors.msg: The seller address is not valid

errors.name: BudgetExhausted
errors.msg: The monthly spending limit has been reached

errors.name: InsufficientBudget
errors.msg: The budget does not hold enough SOL for this payment

errors.name: InvalidSessionKey
errors.msg: The session key is not the one registered for this budget

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: The token does not match this budget

errors.name: ConfigMissing
errors.msg: This deployment has no fee config yet

errors.name: InvalidConfigAdmin
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize the config

errors.name: ProgramNotUpgradeable
errors.msg: This program is not upgradeable, so it cannot bootstrap a config

errors.name: InvalidSessionFloat
errors.msg: The session float must cover one payment's rents

errors.name: TreasuryUnderfunded
errors.msg: The treasury cannot cover the refund it owes

errors.name: FeeModeUnsupported
errors.msg: This fee mode is not supported yet

types.name: Budget
docs: The buyer's monthly spending pot: lamports held by the program plus the
rules that make the session key's signatures safe. Seeded by the buyer's
wallet, so there is exactly one per buyer.

fields.name: buyer
docs: Main wallet — funds, refills and closes the pot. The only wallet
that ever signs for this feature.

fields.name: session_key
docs: App-generated key allowed to spend from the pot without the wallet.

fields.name: monthly_limit
docs: Ceiling for one calendar month, in lamports.

fields.name: spent
docs: Spent so far in `month_index`.

fields.name: month_index
docs: `year * 12 + month` that `spent` belongs to; a new month resets it.

types.name: Config
docs: The program's singleton fee policy and treasury pointers.
Created once per deployment by the program's upgrade authority, which
becomes `admin`. Settlements read it and never write it; only the admin can
change the policy, and the fee destination is derived from a seed here
rather than named by a caller, so no settlement can redirect it.

fields.name: admin
docs: The upgrade authority that initialized the config. It may change the
policy and withdraw treasury surplus, nothing else.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Seller-side fee in basis points (200 = 2%).

fields.name: fixed_fee_lamports
docs: Flat lamport fee added on top of the proportional one.

fields.name: fee_mode
docs: Who pays the fee.

fields.name: session_fee_float
docs: Lamports parked on a session key so its silent transactions can pay
their own network fees. Replaces the old hardcoded float.

fields.name: reference
docs: Free-form lookup key chosen when the invoice was opened.

fields.name: amount
docs: Price in lamports.

fields.name: memo
docs: Human readable invoice note.

fields.name: payer
docs: Set once the invoice has been settled.

types.name: PaymentReceipt
docs: The permanent record of a settled invoice — SOL or token.
The temporary `Payment`/`TokenPayment` account is created, settled and
closed inside one transaction; this receipt is what survives. Its address is
derived from the invoice address (`["payment-receipt", invoice]`), and
`settled_at` doubles as the replay guard: a second settlement of the same
invoice finds a receipt with `settled_at != 0`.
One type for both currencies, with the mint carrying the difference
(`Pubkey::default()` for SOL): a watcher holding only an invoice address can
then find its receipt with one derivation instead of guessing whether the
invoice was priced in SOL or a token.

fields.name: invoice
docs: The invoice PDA this receipt belongs to, so a program-wide scan can name
the invoice without re-deriving it.

fields.name: mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` for a SOL invoice.

fields.name: payer
docs: Wallet or session key that signed the settlement.

fields.name: closed_at
docs: Equal to `settled_at`: the invoice account closes in the settle
transaction, so the record is complete the moment it is written.

types.name: TokenBudget
docs: A buyer's monthly spending pot for one token: the vault holds the tokens
and this account holds the rules the session key's signatures obey.

fields.name: buyer
docs: Main wallet — funds, refills and closes the pot.

fields.name: session_key
docs: App-generated key allowed to spend from the vault without the wallet.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token this budget is denominated in.

fields.name: monthly_limit
docs: Ceiling for one calendar month, in the mint's base units.

fields.name: spent
docs: Spent so far in `month_index`.

fields.name: month_index
docs: `year * 12 + month` that `spent` belongs to.

types.name: TokenPayment
docs: An invoice paid in an SPL token. A separate account type from `Payment`
because it records the mint, and keeping it separate leaves every SOL
invoice already on chain readable.

fields.name: reference
docs: Free-form lookup key chosen when the invoice was opened.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token this invoice is priced in.

fields.name: amount
docs: Price in the mint's base units.

fields.name: memo
docs: Human readable invoice note.

fields.name: payer
docs: Set once the invoice has been settled.
